# Connect iPayX to your AI agent

One MCP server. Every AI client. Real-time forensic FX audit for Claude, Cursor, Cline, Perplexity and beyond.

MCP Server URL

`https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp` Copy

## One-click configuration

Claude Desktop — claude\_desktop\_config.json Copy

```
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ipayx-fx-audit": {
      "url": "https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp",
      "transport": "streamable-http"
    }
  }
}
```

Cursor — \~/.cursor/mcp.json Copy

```
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ipayx": {
      "url": "https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Cline — settings JSON Copy

```
{
  "ipayx-fx-audit": {
    "url": "https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp",
    "type": "streamable-http",
    "disabled": false
  }
}
```

Perplexity — Connector setup Copy

```
Connector URL: https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp
Type: MCP (Streamable HTTP)
Auth: None (public tools rate-limited per IP)
```

## Exposed tools

`check_fx_rate`

Live mid-market rate + optional spread analysis.

`audit_transaction`

0-10 forensic score with bps spread and hidden fees.

`full_forensic_report`

Full report with AI narrative and shareable Proof-Link.
